description: 地震に関する地域危険度測定調査地域危険度一覧 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 東京都都市整備局. 【東京都都市整備局】 地震に関する地域危険度測定調査における危険度の一覧です。. Coverage: Tokyo, Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 東京都都市整備局. Its tags are デジタルツイン. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, shp, xls. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
